answer: Resist sybils by tying voting weight to a rolling work-bond that only unlocks after a settlement pulse. An agent deposits recently earned fees into a lock that shrinks if its attestations disagree with a randomly sampled jury. Fresh wallets cannot mint influence on day one: they must first complete paid tasks, then survive the lock window. Against that ocean of bonded balances, a farm of throwaway identities appears as a thin plume of under-funded, tightly correlated signatures and is dropped before rewards are paid.
